"'''Need You Tonight'''" is a song by the Australian rock band [[INXS]], released as the lead single from their sixth studio album, ''[[Kick (INXS album)|Kick]]'' (1987). In additional to reaching number three in Australia, the song became a chart hit worldwide, peaking at number one on the US [[Billboard Hot 100|''Billboard'' Hot 100]] chart, giving INXS their only number-one single in the United States. It also entered the top five in Canada, Ireland, New Zealand, South Africa, and the United Kingdom.

In February 2014, after the [[Seven Network|Channel 7]] screening of the ''[[INXS: Never Tear Us Apart]]'' mini-series, "Need You Tonight" charted again in [[Australia]] via download sales. It peaked at No. 28 on the ARIA Singles Chart.<ref name="AUS"/>  In January 2018, as part of [[Triple M]]'s "Ozzest 100", the 'most Australian' songs of all time, "Need You Tonight" was ranked number 69.<ref>{{cite news|title= Here Are the Songs That Made Triple M's 'Ozzest 100' |work= [[Music Feeds]] |date= 27 January 2018 |access-date= 4 January 2020 |url= http://musicfeeds.com.au/news/songs-made-triple-ms-ozzest-100/}}</ref> In 2025, the song was ranked at number 59 on the [[Triple J Hottest 100 of Australian Songs]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Countdown #1 to #100 – Hottest 100 Australian Songs |url=https://www.abc.net.au/triplej/countdown/hottest100/1-100 |access-date=26 July 2025 |website=[[Triple J]] |language=en-AU}}</ref>

"Need You Tonight" is a song by the Australian rock band INXS, released as the lead single from their sixth studio album, Kick (1987). In additional to reaching number three in Australia, the song became a chart hit worldwide, peaking at number one on the US Billboard Hot 100 chart, giving INXS their only number-one single in the United States. It also entered the top five in Canada, Ireland, New Zealand, South Africa, and the United Kingdom.

In February 2014, after the Channel 7 screening of the INXS: Never Tear Us Apart mini-series, "Need You Tonight" charted again in Australia via download sales. It peaked at No. 28 on the ARIA Singles Chart.  In January 2018, as part of Triple M's "Ozzest 100", the 'most Australian' songs of all time, "Need You Tonight" was ranked number 69. In 2025, the song was ranked at number 59 on the Triple J Hottest 100 of Australian Songs.

[[Rogue Traders]] covered and remixed "Need You Tonight" and released it as a single in Australia. The song was renamed "One of My Kind", where it reached No. 10 on the Australian Top 100 Singles Chart, becoming their first top-10 hit. "One of My Kind" is the second single released by the [[Rogue Traders]] for their debut album ''[[We Know What You're Up To]]''.{{fact|date=January 2021}}

The music video is set in a dance party where the lizard on the single cover wanders around looking for a girl of his kind. He finds one looking lonely. The two sit together and he sings the line 'you're one of my kind' before the video ends.<ref>{{YouTube|css3LKdIrs0|"One of My Kind Music Video"}}</ref>

The Sam Bennetts and [[Rising Sun Pictures]] directed music video was nominated for [[ARIA Award for Best Video|Best Video]] at the [[ARIA Music Awards of 2003]].<ref name="Video">ARIA Award previous winners. {{cite web|url=https://www.ariaawards.com.au/history/award/Best-Video?view=list|title=Winners by Award – Artisan Awards – Best Video |publisher=Australian Recording Industry Association (ARIA)|access-date= 12 December 2019 }}</ref>

sections.heading: Other cover versions
sections.wikitext:
*Australian singer [[Kylie Minogue]] performed the song as part of the setlist of her [[Kiss Me Once Tour]]. Minogue, a one-time romantic partner of the late INXS frontman Michael Hutchence, considered her performances of the song to be a tribute to him.<ref>{{cite news|first= Andrei |last= Harmsworth |title= Exclusive: Kylie Minogue opens up about 'sexy' tribute to Michael Hutchence |newspaper= [[Metro (British newspaper)|Metro]] |date= 30 September 2014 |access-date= 9 November 2020 |url= https://metro.co.uk/2014/09/30/exclusive-kylie-minogue-opens-up-about-sexy-tribute-to-michael-hutchence-4886967/}}</ref>
*In March 2010, UK rapper [[Professor Green]] released a song based entirely on the song called "[[I Need You Tonight (Professor Green song)|I Need You Tonight]]".<ref>{{cite web|title= Is anyone ever going to use INXS's "Need You Tonight" in the manner it deserves? |work= My Chemical Toilet |date= 15 March 2010 |access-date= 7 May 2015 |url= http://www.mychemicaltoilet.com/2010/03/professor-green-inxs-need-you-tonight/4412/}}</ref>

*Australian singer Kylie Minogue performed the song as part of the setlist of her Kiss Me Once Tour. Minogue, a one-time romantic partner of the late INXS frontman Michael Hutchence, considered her performances of the song to be a tribute to him.
*In March 2010, UK rapper Professor Green released a song based entirely on the song called "I Need You Tonight".
*In June 2016, American singer Bonnie Raitt recorded a live version at Orpheum Theatre (Boston)
*English singer and songwriter Dua Lipa's 2020 single "Break My Heart" interpolates the song's guitar riff.
